# swithAI

> swithAI is an AI-powered fitness and wellness app for iOS and Android. It brings training, nutrition, activity, and mind and wellness tracking into one app, with goal-based coaching on top.

swithAI is built and published by Jason Abbamonte LLC.

## Get the app

- [swithAI on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/swithai/id6783848103): iOS
- [swithAI on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wellnesschampion.app): Android

## What it covers

- Training: log workouts from an exercise library and track sets and progress
- Nutrition: log food and track calories and macronutrients against daily targets
- Activity: track cardio and daily activity
- Mind & Wellness: track mood, sleep, breathing and recovery practices
- Goal: set a goal and follow a plan across the four pillars
